void merge(int a[], int b[], int c[], int p, int q, int r) {
    int n1 = q - p + 1;
    int n2 = r - q;
    int* L = new int[n1 + 1];
    int* R = new int[n2 + 1];
    int* L1 = new int[n1 + 1];
    int* R1 = new int[n2 + 1];
    int* L2 = new int[n1 + 1];
    int* R2 = new int[n2 + 1];

    for (int i = 0; i < n1; i++) {
        L[i] = a[p + i];
        L1[i] = b[p + i];
        L2[i] = c[p + i];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n2; i++) {
        R[i] = a[q + 1 + i];
        R1[i] = b[q + 1 + i];
        R2[i] = c[q + 1 + i];
    }
    L[n1] = R[n2] = INF;
    L1[n1] = R1[n2] = INF;
    L2[n1] = R2[n2] = INF;

    int j = 0, k = 0;
    for (int i = p; i <= r; i++) {
        if (L[j] < R[k]) {
            a[i] = L[j];
            b[i] = L1[j];
            c[i] = L2[j++];
        } else if (L[j] > R[k]) {
            a[i] = R[k];
            b[i] = R1[k];

            }
        }
    }
    delete[] L;
    delete[] R;
    delete[] L1;
    delete[] R1;
    delete[] L2;
    delete[] R2;
}

int* sieve(int n) {
    int* a = new int[n + 1];
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i] = 1;
    }
    for (int i = 2; i * i <= n; i++) {
        if (a[i] == 1) {
            for (int k = 2; i * k <= n; k++) {
                a[i * k] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return a;
}

bool prime(int n) {
    if (n == 1) return true;
    for (int i = 2; i * i <= n; i++) {
        if (n % i == 0) return false;
    }

}

long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {

vector<int> gd(int a, int b) {
    int m = (int)gcd(a, b);
    vector<int> q;
    for (int i = 1; i * i <= m; ++i) {
        if (m % i == 0) {
            q.push_back(i);
            if (i != m / i) {
                q.push_back(m / i);
            }
        }
    }
    return q;
}

int divisors(int n, int m) {
    if (n - (m + (m * m)) >= 0) {
        return m;
    }
    for (int i = (int)sqrt(m); i >= 1; i--) {
        if (m % i == 0 && n - (m + (m * i)) >= 0) {
            return i;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

bool cal(int val, int k, int t) {
    int res = val, p = 1;
    while (val / (int)pow(k, p) > 0) {
        res += val / (int)pow(k, p);
        p++;
    }
    return res >= t;
}

int Last_Ocuu(int a[], int n, long long v) {
    int start = 0, end = n - 1, ans = -1;
    while (start <= end) {
        int mid = (start + end) >> 1;
        if (a[mid] >= v) {
            ans = mid;
            end = mid - 1;
        } else {
            start = mid + 1;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

bool Last_Ocuu(long long a[], int n, long long v) {

class Scannerr {
public:
    string line;
    int pos;
    
    Scannerr(istream& s) {
        getline(s, line);
        pos = 0;
    }
    
    string next() {
        while (pos < line.size() && line[pos] == ' ') pos++;
        string res = "";
        while (pos < line.size() && line[pos] != ' ') {
            res += line[pos];
            pos++;
        }
        if (pos < line.size()) pos++;
        return res;
    }
    
    double nextDouble() {
        string x = next();
        double res = 0, f = 1;
        bool dec = false, neg = false;
        int start = 0;
        if (x[0] == '-') {
            neg = true;
            start++;
        }
        for (int i = start; i < x.length(); i++) {
            if (x[i] == '.') {
                res = stod(x.substr(start, i - start));
                dec = true;
                f = 1;
            } else if (dec) {
                f *= 10;
            }
        }
        if (!dec) {
            res = stod(x.substr(start));
        } else {
            res += stod(x.substr(x.find('.') + 1)) / f;
        }
        return res * (neg ? -1 : 1);
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
    
    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
    
    string nextLine() {
        return line;
    }
};

    vector<int> sol;
    int even = 0, odd = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        a[i] = in.nextInt();
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) {
            ++even;
        } else {
            ++odd;
        }
        if (even == odd) {
            sol.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
        }
    }
    
    sort(sol.begin(), sol.end());
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < sol.size(); i++) {
        if (sol[i] <= B) {
            ++ans;
            B -= sol[i];
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
